entries.name: Flowing Palm
entries.desc: Two flowing palm strikes with the free hand; any weapon. Tier 3: slows the target by 20% for 2 s.

entries.name: Jade Thrust
entries.desc: A piercing thrust that hits two foes in a line. Tier 5: becomes a Qi lance.

entries.name: Cloudpiercing Stroke
entries.desc: A rising cut in a wide arc. Tier 3: +10% crit.

entries.name: Reedcutter Slash
entries.desc: A quick slash with a 20% chance to bleed for 3 s.

entries.name: Riverstone Sweep
entries.desc: A heavy sweep that strikes everything in front and knocks it back.

entries.name: Twin Reed Shot
entries.desc: Two arrows at once. Tier 3: a third arrow.

entries.name: Tiger Rush
entries.desc: Dash 120 units and strike with the weight of a tiger. A body technique: from Copper Body it can spend HP when QI runs short.

entries.name: Willow Leaf Parry
entries.desc: Enter a stance: the next parry within 2 s counters for 200%.

entries.name: Dragon Tail Sweep
entries.desc: A 180-degree sweep that hits all nearby foes.

entries.name: Shadow Flick
entries.desc: Backstep, then throw a knife 300 units.

entries.name: Bell Toll Strike
entries.desc: A ringing blow with a 25% chance to stun for 0.6 s.

entries.name: Pinning Arrow
entries.desc: An arrow that roots the target for 1.5 s.

entries.name: Mountain Cleaver
entries.desc: A two-handed cleave through up to three foes; it always breaks their armour for 4 s.

entries.name: Gale Fan
entries.desc: A fan-stroke of wind 180 units long that throws up to four foes into the air.

entries.name: Reed Song
entries.desc: Three notes that seek their mark; each may confuse its target for 1.5 s.

entries.name: Thunder Dao Arc
entries.desc: A heavy arc of sabre Qi that rolls 300 units and breaks the armour of all it cuts.

entries.name: Returning Crane Fan
entries.desc: Throw the fan: it flies 300 units and comes back, cutting and lifting everything it passes, both ways.

entries.name: Clear Heart Melody
entries.desc: A calming melody: you and every ally beside you recover 4% of your health a second for 6 s.

entries.name: Rising Tide
entries.desc: A wave of Qi strikes all foes within 200 units and slows them 20%.

entries.name: Palm Wave
entries.desc: A palm of Qi that flies 360 units and pierces one foe.

entries.name: Crescent Arc
entries.desc: A crescent of sword Qi that travels 360 units along the depth band.

entries.name: Spear Lance
entries.desc: A lance of Qi hitting everything in a 300-unit line. +10% penetration.

entries.name: Sword Release
entries.desc: The jian leaves your hand and strikes on its own for 8 s (60% a strike, 1.5 a second); your hands fight with Qi palms. Use again to call it back.

entries.name: Sword Swarm
entries.desc: Three swords of Qi (nine with the Nine Swords Array) orbit you for 12 s and strike the nearest foes in turn. One sword for each 10 Spirit. Use again to call them back.

entries.name: Flying Blades
entries.desc: Three seeking blades.

entries.name: Earthshaker Wave
entries.desc: A ground wave that knocks back everything within 300 units ahead.

entries.name: Vine Snare
entries.desc: Vines root up to three foes for 2 s.

entries.name: Rain of Reeds
entries.desc: Five arrows rain on an area.

entries.name: Stone Skin
entries.desc: +30% Physical Defense for 8 s. A body technique: from Copper Body it can spend HP when QI runs short.

entries.name: Gale Step
entries.desc: Dash 200 units through enemies, striking all you pass.

entries.name: Mountain Shaker
entries.desc: A slam with a 30% chance to stun for 0.8 s; knockback. A body technique: from Copper Body it can spend HP when QI runs short.

entries.name: Ember Burst
entries.desc: An explosion of fire within 150 units that burns for 3 s.

entries.name: Still Water Focus
entries.desc: Your next technique hits its perfect-timing bonus.

entries.name: Shadowstep Cut
entries.desc: Blink behind the target and cut.

entries.name: Cloud Descent
entries.desc: An aerial dive that strikes everything below (flying only).

entries.name: Mirror Mind Spike
entries.desc: A spike of will that ignores armour; 20% confusion.

entries.name: Soul Lantern Ward
entries.desc: A ward that absorbs damage equal to 10% of your max HP for 6 s.

entries.name: Sense Lock
entries.desc: Fix your Spirit Sense on one foe within 420 for 8 s: it cannot evade you or hide from you.

entries.name: Phantom Double
entries.desc: Leave an illusion of yourself where you stand for 6 s (+1 s a Soul Dao tier). Foes within 500 turn on it until it has been struck three times. Bosses see through it.

entries.name: Soul Search
entries.desc: A spike into an elite's soul that ignores armour. If it dies within 12 s, you read its memories (a Codex page) and find what it hid (an extra drop).

entries.name: Crimson Palm
entries.desc: A palm soaked in your own blood: costs 5% of your health. Blood path only.

entries.name: Blood River Slash
entries.desc: A river of blood-red Qi that runs 360 units through every foe: costs 10% of your health. Blood path only.

entries.name: Sanguine Lotus
entries.desc: A lotus of blood opens around you and strikes every foe within 200: costs 15% of your health. Blood path only.

entries.name: Golden Body
entries.desc: Hold a vow and your body turns to gold for 10 s: +25% Physical Defence and Qi Resistance, +15% healing received.

entries.name: Venom Needles
entries.desc: Three seeking needles; each poisons its mark (2% of its health a second for 5 s).

entries.name: Miasma Palm
entries.desc: A palm of green miasma that poisons every foe within 160 on both sides (3% of their health a second for 6 s).

entries.name: Splashed Ink
entries.desc: A flick of ink 150 ahead that strikes three foes and seals their Qi for 2 s (the brush's talisman).

entries.name: Cursive Storm
entries.desc: Four running strokes of fire script; every foe they touch is written with a burning talisman.

entries.name: Stilling Peal
entries.desc: A peal on both sides: every foe within 200 is stunned for 0.8 s.

entries.name: Qi Seal Toll
entries.desc: One low toll at a foe 240 ahead: its techniques are sealed for 3 s.

entries.name: Wardens Call
entries.desc: The Wardens' call: you and every ally within 300 heal 6% of your health over 8 s and gain 10% defence.

entries.name: Upright Glyph
entries.desc: Write the glyph for Upright in the air: it strikes every foe within 220 ahead. Its strength follows your Insight. Confucian path only.

entries.name: Benevolent Script
entries.desc: Write Benevolence over yourself and your allies within 260: each heals 10% of their health over 6 s. Confucian path only.

entries.name: Rite Seal Script
entries.desc: Seal the ground with the Rites: every foe within 240 on both sides is rooted for 1.5 s and struck in the soul. Its strength follows your Insight. Confucian path only.

entries.name: Blood Burning
entries.desc: Burn your own blood: +50% attack for 10 s. It costs 30% of your HP and leaves a body injury.

entries.name: Glimpse of Heaven
entries.desc: Borrow a glimpse of the heavens. Ignores 20% Qi Resistance.

Hundred Springs Rising
entries.desc: Springs rise under every foe near you for 6 s and slow them.

entries.name: Nine Undertows
entries.desc: Nine water blades circle you and pull what they cut.

entries.name: Heron Stands in the Flood
entries.desc: Rooted and unmovable for 10 s: your guard holds harder and your Qi runs deep.

entries.name: Rain Over Nine Ferries
entries.desc: A rain over the field: your arts gain the Water's power and your allies heal as it falls.

entries.name: Glacier Heart Mantle
entries.desc: A mantle of old ice for 10 s: Qi strikes glance off you.

entries.name: Riptide Procession
entries.desc: For 12 s every Water art you cast pulls harder.

entries.name: Tidal Bore Charge
entries.desc: One great wave at a single foe that finds the gaps in its resistance.

entries.name: Mirrorwater Downpour
entries.desc: A rain that confuses every foe beneath it.

entries.name: Star-Sea Undertow
entries.desc: The sea of stars pulls every foe near you toward one point.

entries.name: Returning Tide of Lanterns
entries.desc: Tide-lanterns go out, find the foes and come back.

entries.name: Leviathan's Breath
entries.desc: The deep's breath on one foe, through its resistance.

entries.name: Harbour of Returning Waves
entries.desc: An image of you stands in the harbour and draws the foes away.

entries.name: Thousand-Root Stillness
entries.desc: Roots rise from the ground around you and hold every foe.

entries.name: Bamboo Grove of Blades
entries.desc: Green bamboo blades circle out and strike the nearest foes.

entries.name: Old Willow Takes Root
entries.desc: You stand as the old willow: bark on your skin, roots in the ground.

entries.name: Seedfall Over the Terraces
entries.desc: Seeds fall over the field: your arts gain the Wood's power.

entries.name: Banyan's Hundred Arms
entries.desc: The banyan lends you its hanging roots to strike with.

entries.name: Thornwood Reaping
entries.desc: One cut that reaps what the thorns have held.

entries.name: Strangler Fig Embrace
entries.desc: The fig closes over every foe near you and roots it.

entries.name: Pollen-Storm Mirage
entries.desc: A shape of you in the pollen draws the foes' eyes.

entries.name: Lantern-Moss Hymn
entries.desc: Moss glows under the lanterns: your arts gain the Wood's power.

entries.name: Mantis Prays at Midnight
entries.desc: The mantis waits, then strikes once, deep.

entries.name: Star-Seed Canopy
entries.desc: A canopy of star-seeds falls and roots the foes under it.

entries.name: Cicada Sheds Its Shell
entries.desc: You slip out of your own shape; the foes strike the husk.

entries.name: Kiln-Keeper's Mantle
entries.desc: The kiln's heat wraps you for 10 s and feeds your Qi strikes.

entries.name: Nine Cinder Blades
entries.desc: Nine cinders circle you and burn what they touch.

entries.name: Charcoal Road Burning
entries.desc: The ground around you smoulders and burns every foe on it.

entries.name: Firefly Lanterns Descend
entries.desc: Fireflies settle on your arts: they gain the Fire's power.

entries.name: Pyre That Answers Twice
entries.desc: A shape of flame stands where you stood and takes the blows.

entries.name: Sunscar Verdict
entries.desc: One blow of the scar's heat, through the foe's resistance.

entries.name: Ash-Wind Procession
entries.desc: The ash-wind rides with you: your arts gain the Fire's power.

entries.name: Magma Rain on Red Dunes
entries.desc: Molten rain on everything near you; it burns.

entries.name: Red Kite Circles Nine Times
entries.desc: Burning kites circle out and fall on the foes.

entries.name: Heart of a Falling Comet
entries.desc: A comet's heart burns in you for 10 s.

entries.name: Forge of the Burning Stars
entries.desc: The star-forge opens under the foes and burns them.

entries.name: Cinder Script Finale
entries.desc: The last stroke of burning script on one foe.

entries.name: Ox Plants Its Hooves
entries.desc: Nothing moves you for 10 s; blows break on your hide.

entries.name: Seven Riverstones Circling
entries.desc: Seven riverstones circle you and strike the nearest foes.

entries.name: Quarry Floor Collapses
entries.desc: The ground around you gives way and stuns every foe on it.

entries.name: Pebble Rain Over Terraces
entries.desc: A patter of pebbles: your arts gain the Earth's power.

entries.name: Sand-King's Echoing Step
entries.desc: A shape of sand walks where you walked and draws the foes.

entries.name: Landslide Judgement
entries.desc: The mountain's full weight on one foe.

entries.name: Dune Sea Swallows All
entries.desc: The dunes rise around you and swallow the foes' footing.

entries.name: Tortoise Carries the Hill
entries.desc: A hill on your back for 10 s: slow, and unbreakable.

entries.name: March of Mountain Roots
entries.desc: The mountains march with you: your arts gain the Earth's power.

entries.name: Nine Crystal Shards Wheel
entries.desc: Crystal shards wheel around you and strike.

entries.name: Pangolin Rolls the Stars
entries.desc: Rolled tight, then one great blow.

entries.name: Weight of a Fallen Star
entries.desc: A fallen star's weight presses every foe near you down.

entries.name: Bronze Bell Body
entries.desc: Your skin rings like bronze for 10 s.

entries.name: Hundred Needles Hover
entries.desc: A hundred needles hang in the air and fly at the foes.

entries.name: Anvil Rings Back
entries.desc: An image of you takes the blows as an anvil takes the hammer.

entries.name: Rain of Copper Coins
entries.desc: Coins rain on every foe near you and break their armour.

entries.name: Nine War-Gongs Sound
entries.desc: Nine gongs sound: your arts gain the Metal's power.

entries.name: Starsteel Unmaking
entries.desc: One cut of starsteel through the foe's resistance.

entries.name: Iron Chains Bind the Pass
entries.desc: Chains close over the foes near you and break their armour.

entries.name: Hawk of Quicksilver
entries.desc: Quicksilver hawks fly out and strike the foes.

entries.name: White Tiger Descends
entries.desc: The white tiger's hide on you for 10 s.

entries.name: Mirror-Steel Twin Blade
entries.desc: Your twin in mirror-steel stands and draws the foes.

entries.name: Meteor Iron Barrage
entries.desc: Meteor iron falls in shards on the nearest foes.

entries.name: Every Edge Remembers
entries.desc: Every edge you carry remembers: your arts gain the Metal's power.

entries.name: Crane Dances on the Gale
entries.desc: You dance on the gale for 10 s: quick, and hard to strike.

entries.name: Swallow Blades Wheeling
entries.desc: Swallow-shaped blades wheel out and strike.

entries.name: Updraft Over Cloud Stair
entries.desc: An updraft lifts every foe near you off its feet.

entries.name: Hundred Kites Take Flight
entries.desc: A hundred kites rise: your arts gain the Wind's power.

entries.name: Echo in the Harpy Canyons
entries.desc: Your echo stands in the canyon and draws the foes.

entries.name: Eye of the Cyclone Cut
entries.desc: From the calm eye, one cut through the foe's resistance.

entries.name: Sky-Road Unrolled
entries.desc: The sky-road unrolls under the foes and throws them up.

entries.name: Egret Flock Returning
entries.desc: Egrets of wind fly out and strike the foes.

entries.name: North Wind Mantle
entries.desc: The north wind wraps you for 10 s.

entries.name: Jet-Stream Severing
entries.desc: One cut riding the high wind, through the foe's resistance.

entries.name: Storm-Front Advancing
entries.desc: The storm-front walks with you: your arts gain the Wind's power.

entries.name: Twin Kestrels of Dusk
entries.desc: A kestrel's shadow of you hangs in the air and draws the foes.

entries.name: Drum-Beast Awakens
entries.desc: The drum-beast wakes in you for 10 s: every blow falls faster.

entries.name: Nine Sparks Circling
entries.desc: Nine sparks circle out and shock the nearest foes.

entries.name: Field of Rolling Thunder
entries.desc: Thunder rolls over the ground around you and shocks every foe.

entries.name: Stormbird Carries Word
entries.desc: The stormbird flies with your arts: they gain the Thunder's power.

entries.name: Thunderclap Twice Heard
entries.desc: The first clap is you; the second is your image, and they chase it.

entries.name: Lightning Scar Verdict
entries.desc: The scar's lightning on one foe, through its resistance.

entries.name: Storm-Horns Call the Rain
entries.desc: Storm-horns call: your arts gain the Thunder's power.

entries.name: Thunder-Plain Hailstorm
entries.desc: Hail and lightning on everything near you.

entries.name: Drums That Beat Themselves
entries.desc: Drums of lightning beat on their own and strike the foes.

entries.name: Body of the Storm-Eye
entries.desc: The storm's eye in your body for 10 s.

entries.name: Ram Breaks the Sky Gate
entries.desc: The ram's charge through a single foe's resistance.

entries.name: Forked Light Twins
entries.desc: A fork of the lightning stands as you and draws the foes.

entries.name: Lanterns Walk the Night
entries.desc: Lanterns walk beside you: your arts gain the Soul's power.

entries.name: Shadow Blades Unseen
entries.desc: Blades of shadow circle out unseen and strike.

entries.name: Owl Watches the Dreamer
entries.desc: An owl's dream of you sits where you sat; the foes turn on it.

entries.name: Room of a Thousand Candles
entries.desc: A thousand candles around you; every foe in their light loses its way.

entries.name: Face in the Mirror-Lake
entries.desc: The lake's face over yours for 10 s: the mind is hard to strike.

entries.name: Fox Takes Its Due
entries.desc: The fox's one bite, through the foe's resistance.

entries.name: Tide of Lost Dreams
entries.desc: A tide of old dreams around you; the foes forget which way they faced.

entries.name: Moth-Wing Lanterns
entries.desc: Moth-winged lanterns fly out and strike the foes.

entries.name: Voice of the First Dream
entries.desc: The first dream speaks with your voice and draws the foes.

entries.name: Ghost-Light Severance
entries.desc: A cold light on one foe, through its resistance.

entries.name: Night Cat Walks Alone
entries.desc: The night cat's step for 10 s: quiet, quick, hard to strike.

entries.name: Hall of Hollow Echoes
entries.desc: Echoes fill the hall around you and turn the foes about.

entries.name: Empty Hand Holds the Sky
entries.desc: Nothing in the hand, everything in it, for 10 s.

entries.name: Single Line Unbroken
entries.desc: One straight line through one foe and its resistance.

entries.name: Straight Road Walked Far
entries.desc: The straight road under you: your arts gain their power.

entries.name: Circle Drawn in One Breath
entries.desc: A circle drawn in one breath holds every foe inside it.

entries.name: Nameless Double
entries.desc: A double without a name stands and draws the foes.

entries.name: Unborn Blades
entries.desc: Blades that were never forged circle out and strike.

entries.name: Boundless Plain
entries.desc: A plain with no edge opens around you and holds the foes.

entries.name: Unwritten Last Stroke
entries.desc: The stroke no one has written yet, on one foe.

entries.name: Silence Before the Bell
entries.desc: The silence before the bell: your arts gain their power.

entries.name: Blade Before Form
entries.desc: The blade before it had a shape, for 10 s.

entries.name: One Hundred Plain Staves
entries.desc: A hundred plain staves fall on the nearest foes.

entries.name: Blank Page of Heaven
entries.desc: A blank page opens under the foes and holds them.

entries.name: Orbit of the Seven Lamps
entries.desc: Seven lamps orbit you and pull the foes to their circle.

entries.name: Blades Between the Stars
entries.desc: Blades step through the space between and strike.

entries.name: Fold the Distance Shut
entries.desc: The distance folds; one blow lands where the foe stands.

entries.name: Two Places at Once
entries.desc: You stand in two places; the foes choose the wrong one.

entries.name: Hammerfall Knuckles
entries.desc: A knuckle driven down like a hammer on one foe; it stuns for 0.8 s.

entries.name: Palm That Moves Mountains
entries.desc: A palm-wave 300 long that throws back everything in its way.

entries.name: Spear Draws the Horizon
entries.desc: A thrust that runs to the horizon: every foe in a 360 line, +15% penetration.

entries.name: Hundred Point Storm
entries.desc: Five thrusts faster than the eye; each breaks armour.

entries.name: Shadow Knife Relay
entries.desc: Four knives that find four throats in turn.

entries.name: Mountain Parting Sabre
entries.desc: A sabre-wave that parts the ground and sunders all it cuts.

entries.name: Staff Sweeps the Courtyard
entries.desc: A sweep around you that knocks every foe off its feet.

entries.name: Pillar Holds Up Heaven
entries.desc: Down from the air like a pillar; every foe below is stunned.

entries.name: Arrow Finds the Heart
entries.desc: One arrow that never misses the heart: it ignores 20% resistance.

entries.name: Sky Filled With Arrows
entries.desc: Seven volleys fill the sky over the foes.

entries.name: Fan Folds the Wind
entries.desc: The fan folds the wind and brings it home through every foe twice.

entries.name: Thousand Leaves Fall
entries.desc: A thousand leaves fall on the foes and root them.

entries.name: Song Across the River
entries.desc: A song heard across the river: you and every ally heal 6% over 8 s.

entries.name: Bell That Stills the Heart
entries.desc: The bell stills every heart near it: foes are confused.

entries.name: Characters Leave the Page
entries.desc: The written characters rise from the page and strike the nearest foes.

entries.name: Final Stroke of the Master
entries.desc: The last stroke of a master's hand on one foe.

entries.name: Mirror of Still Water
entries.desc: Still water over your skin for 8 s: a shield of 12% of your health.

entries.name: Great River Turns Back
entries.desc: The great river turns back through every foe ahead and slows them.

entries.name: Spring Rain Greening
entries.desc: A spring rain: you and your allies heal 8% over 8 s.

entries.name: Forest Rises From Ash
entries.desc: A forest rises around you and roots every foe in it.

entries.name: Mountain Does Not Kneel
entries.desc: For 8 s you do not kneel: +35% physical defence, and nothing knocks you back.

entries.name: Earth Opens Its Mouth
entries.desc: The earth opens around you and stuns every foe.

entries.name: Stepping on the Wind
entries.desc: Step on the wind through every foe in 240.

entries.name: Gale That Clears the Sky
entries.desc: A gale that throws every foe ahead into the air.

entries.name: Hearth Fire Kindled
entries.desc: A hearth-fire kindled at your feet; it burns every foe near you.

entries.name: Sky Set Alight
entries.desc: The sky catches fire and falls on the foes.

entries.name: Hundred Refinings
entries.desc: A body refined a hundred times for 8 s: harder, and sharper.

entries.name: Edge Without a Blade
entries.desc: An edge with no blade flies 360 and sunders all it cuts.

entries.name: Drumbeat Before the Storm
entries.desc: One drumbeat: two foes are sealed and shocked.

entries.name: Verdict of the Clouds
entries.desc: The clouds pass their verdict on one foe.

entries.name: Lantern in the Dark Sea
entries.desc: A lantern in the dark sea of the mind: every foe near you loses its way.

entries.name: Folding the Step
entries.desc: Fold the space between you and a foe and strike from behind it.

entries.name: Orbit of Returning Blades
entries.desc: Blades go into orbit and come down on four foes.

entries.name: Tide-Palm
entries.desc: Elder Gu's own palm: a tide of Qi that flies 360, cuts every foe in its path, slows them and draws them in.

entries.name: Willowbark Script
entries.desc: Characters cut into willow bark bind five foes for 2.5 s.

entries.name: Kite-String Cut
entries.desc: Three knives on the wind's string: each passes through two foes and throws them up.

entries.name: Mudskipper Kick
entries.desc: Skid 180 through the mud and kick every foe you pass back and down; they wade for 2 s.

entries.name: Well-Bottom Sutra
entries.desc: A toll from the bottom of the well: foes around you are struck in the soul and you are shielded for 8% of your health.

entries.name: Monastery Gate Staff
entries.desc: The gate-keeper's staff: a 3 s guard that answers every blow, and a shield of 6% of your health while you hold it.

entries.name: Quarry-Breaker Fist
entries.desc: The miners' fist: one blow that cracks armour like rock and may stun.

entries.name: Grotto Moon Flick
entries.desc: Step through the moonlight behind a foe and flick the knife: +25% crit.

entries.name: Vale Serpent Spear
entries.desc: The spear coils like the vale's serpent: four foes in a line, each left bitten (2% of its health a second for 4 s).

entries.name: Frost-Shrine Sword
entries.desc: A sword-crescent cut from the shrine's ice: it may freeze what it cuts for a second.

entries.name: Echo-Cliff Refrain
entries.desc: Play once and the cliffs play four times more: five notes that seek their marks.

entries.name: Serpent-Coil Thrust
entries.desc: Coil through the foes around you and draw them to your spear.

entries.name: Surfacing Bell
entries.desc: The drowned shrine's bell rings once: four foes cannot use their arts for 3 s.

entries.name: Scar-Lightning Lance
entries.desc: The lance the lightning taught the stone: a line of thunder 300 long that shocks all it strikes.

entries.name: Hoarfrost Arrow
entries.desc: An arrow kept in ice for longer than its hunter lived: it may freeze its mark.

entries.name: Mirror-Lake Knell
entries.desc: The bell the lake shows: a knell around you that passes armour and turns the foes about.

entries.name: Snowfall Without Sound
entries.desc: Arrive like snow behind a foe and cut: it is slowed 40%.

entries.name: Crypt-Seal Cleave
entries.desc: The cleave the crypt's mirror shows: three foes cut and sealed for 2 s.

entries.name: Sand-Throne Sweep
entries.desc: The throne-hall sweep: every foe around you is stunned.

entries.name: Many-Eyed Pool Air
entries.desc: The toad's hunting hum: six foes are slowed 35% for 3 s.

entries.name: Roost-Scatter Fan
entries.desc: A fan-burst that scatters a roost: every foe around you is thrown up and back.

entries.name: Deck-Cutter Flick
entries.desc: A thrown knife that cuts the deck both ways and may break armour.

entries.name: Ninth Peak Scroll
entries.desc: An older lot than the peaks: the jian flies out five times on its own and may break armour.

entries.name: Star-Sighting Shot
entries.desc: Sight a star and loose: an arrow that reaches 520, never misses and passes 20% of resistance.

entries.name: Upside-Down Staff
entries.desc: Fall up, then down: every foe below is struck and pulled to your staff.

entries.name: Wyrm-Egg Knuckle
entries.desc: Four knuckles harder than wyrm shell; each may crack armour.

entries.name: Hulk-Breaker
entries.desc: The ship-breaker's swing: a wave that sunders armour and throws the foes back.

entries.name: Cove Knife
entries.desc: Three knives thrown the smugglers' way: +20% crit.

entries.name: Broadside Fan
entries.desc: The admiral's order to the guns: four fan-blades at once.

entries.name: Pyre-General's Lance
entries.desc: The lance the pyre-general never used: five foes in a line, burning.

entries.name: Comet-Tail Arrow
entries.desc: An arrow that leaves a burning tail through every foe in its path.

entries.name: Maw-Song
entries.desc: The song before the swallowing: every foe near you is drawn in.

entries.name: Burning-Star Peal
entries.desc: A bell cast from a fallen star: the peal passes armour and burns every foe near you.

entries.name: Breakwater Sword
entries.desc: Hold the line: a 3 s guard that answers every blow, with 20% more defence while it stands.

entries.name: Oar Across the Current
entries.desc: The oar across the current: a sweep that draws every foe around you in.

entries.name: Ferry Pole Vault
entries.desc: Vault on the ferry pole and come down among the foes; they wade for 2 s.

entries.name: Mooring Knot
entries.desc: A mooring knot thrown over four foes: they are held and drawn to you.

entries.name: Lantern At the Bow
entries.desc: A lantern hung at the bow: you and your allies heal 8% over 6 s.

entries.name: Tablet of Dry Wells
entries.desc: A pillar of dry sand on one foe; it stuns.

entries.name: Sand-Glyph Snare
entries.desc: A glyph in the sand holds three foes for 2.2 s.

entries.name: Throne-Dust Veil
entries.desc: A veil of throne dust for 8 s: +30% evasion.

entries.name: Scorpion Script
entries.desc: Three strokes of scorpion script that seek and sting.

entries.name: The King Who Waits
entries.desc: The king who sat three thousand years: the ground around you becomes his hall, and every foe in it is held.

entries.name: Lamp on a Tether
entries.desc: A lamp on a tether swings out to three foes and draws them in.

entries.name: Inverted Stair Kick
entries.desc: Kick down the stair that goes up: every foe below is thrown into the air.

entries.name: Orbit-Stone Sling
entries.desc: Three orbit-stones slung so they curve after their marks.

entries.name: Gravity Knot
entries.desc: A knot in the pull of things: every foe near you falls toward you.

entries.name: Lamp That Circles the Dark
entries.desc: The lamp that circles the dark: lamps orbit you and strike the foes they find.
